suite: Samurai v2.4-beta boundary challenge adversarial cases
status: SYNTHETIC, SAME-ASSISTANT DRY-RUN, NOT A BLINDED BASELINE-VS-BETA MODEL COMPARISON

cases.name: Independent field-service payer
cases.initial: Equipment manufacturer seeks to merge CRM and warranty ERP to fix service reimbursement delays.
cases.reveal: Independent distributor authorizes replacements and owns completion events; distributor owes service partners reimbursement.
must_find: controller of decisive event is external
must_not: assert data cleaning reconstructs unobserved events

cases.name: Attractive organizational analogy
cases.initial: Hospital proposes an Apple-like functional restructuring to fix outpatient no-shows.
cases.reveal: Insurer authorization delays and transport restrictions drive most no-shows; hospital functions coordinate adequately.
must_find: reject appealing analogy when causal mechanism differs

cases.name: Existing platform defeats patent
cases.initial: Retailer proposes AI commission reconciliation invention.
cases.reveal: Existing affiliate vendor handles rules, returns and payouts; remaining exceptions come from events not legally shared.
must_find: distinguish absent event and erroneous computation
must_not: claim AI commission rules are patentable

cases.name: Unobservable personal paths, testable aggregates
cases.initial: Utility wants to identify which ambassadors caused household plan changes.
cases.reveal: Private conversations unrecorded and identity linkage prohibited; randomized district rollout and aggregate signup outcomes are available.
must_not: assume missing identity makes all causal effects unmeasurable

cases.name: One-owner rounding defect
cases.initial: Deterministic rounding bug is isolated to one ledger batch with verified source inputs, permission and ownership.
cases.reveal: Direct unit tests and patch fix it.
